about: Passes that test how obs_mosaic tells mosaics, movies and mosaic movies apart (_judge, u['kind']) and how each plays. expect: mosaic | movie | mosaic_movie | either (the person's call). now: what Auto does today when it differs from expect (a known gap and the phase that closes it). Threads only add entries.

passes.why: Spoke movie: two ring patches filmed back and forth, one frame every 11 s, 8 visits of ~80 frames. Sam's checkpoint 1 pass; was built as a mosaic because merged repeats looked like jumps (fixed by the dwell test).
Shadow boundary, 4 WAC then 10 NAC frames ~197 s apart with exposures 0.3-220 s; too few frames to say.
F-ring movie, 60 frames every 300 s; smeared into a mosaic before the movie test.
Propeller movie, 60 frames every 417 s.
Saturn stare, 1512 frames, six-filter cycle every 21 s; a color movie.
Gray stare; the window asked for its mosaic 43 times before, once after.
1x1 stare cycling filters, no filter taken twice.
In Saturn's Shadow (PIA08329), the mosaic benchmark: 5x5 raster, CL/VIO/IR3 at each pointing.
WAC ring scan, 17 tiles, 9.4 frames across; went blank at tile 12 (W1543828177_1) with the old follow window.
Wide WAC scan, emptied four times with the follow window; one far tile makes the whole footprint large.
Limb scan taking a new filter at every pointing (10 tiles over 13 frames); no filter twice, so no single-filter mosaic until phase 3's gray base.
Per-filter scan, 11 tiles over 11 frames.
Per-filter global map, 6 tiles over 6.5 frames.
North polar raster repeated for hours, laps ~36 min apart inside one pass; the pointings creep 0.13 frame between laps (10 places, each visited ~10 times).

Sam's prime mosaic movie: a 2x2 in 5 filters (20 frames, 24 min) taken 6 times, 74 min apart, Jupiter turning ~60 deg per lap. GAP split it into 6 passes, so the mosaic started from nothing every lap; laps are now one pass (LAP_GAP, LAP_OVERLAP).
18 laps over two observations (A then B), 74 min apart; laps inside each observation join, the change of observation still starts again.
13 laps of a 2x2 inside one observation, ~52 min apart.

passes.now: a mosaic per lap (one observation per lap)
passes.why: 21 laps, one observation each (2X2PLRNC001..021), 5 min apart; laps across observations are not joined yet.

Sam (checkpoint 1, second round): looks like a movie. A one-lap pan along the ring, 34 frames 0.35 frame apart; every frame shows nearly the same rings. A pointing rule for pans also caught radial ring scans (TEMPL55MP001, TEMPU57MP001) and a 1x2 Saturn mosaic, which are good mosaics, so Auto leaves pans as mosaics; telling an along-ring pan apart needs the pictures themselves.
passes.now: mosaic (the window's chip makes it a movie)

passes.why: Sam: debatable. A sparse one-lap map, 6 places 1-2 frames apart (CB3 and MT1), tiles not touching over featureless haze; no place visited twice, so not a mosaic movie. Auto keeps it a mosaic.
